neighbours.label: the first token of a new line when a hard line break falls mid-sentence (verse or OCR'd newspaper columns), especially 'I'
fire:
The body will be brought to
Idaho Falls tomorrow for burial.

Bassanio presently will go aboard;
I have sent twenty out to seek for you.

We all expect a gentle answer, Jew.
I have possessed your Grace of what I purpose.

He pleaded guilty when confronted
with the evidence. It
is the first case of its kind.

Than customary bounty can enforce you.
I never did repent for doing good.

The council met on Tuesday and
It was decided that the road would close.

My lord, the messenger is come;
I pray you hear him speak.

The farmers of the county gathered
in the hall to hear the speech.
quiet: The body will be brought to Idaho Falls tomorrow for burial.
Bassanio presently will go aboard; we have sent twenty out to seek for you.
We all expect a gentle answer, Jew, and we have told the Duke our purpose.
He pleaded guilty when confronted with the evidence, the first case of its kind.
Than customary bounty can enforce you, we never did repent for doing good.
The council met on Tuesday and decided that the road would close.
My lord, the messenger is come; we pray you hear him speak.
The farmers of the county gathered in the hall to hear the speech.
